test_title: PYST 13: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In May 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated 103 redeveloped railway stations under which of the following schemes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrit Bharat Station Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amrit Bharat Station Scheme** is a government initiative aimed at the **redevelopment of railway stations** across India to enhance passenger experience and infrastructure.
 
• The scheme focuses on the **modernization** and **upgradation of facilities** such as waiting areas, ticket counters, parking spaces, and passenger amenities at railway stations.
 
• The initiative envisions the creation of **state-of-the-art railway stations** with improved accessibility, digital integration, and eco-friendly measures, aligning with the government’s vision for infrastructure development.
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** dedicated 103 redeveloped railway stations under this scheme in **May 2025**, reflecting the government’s commitment to enhancing transportation infrastructure.
 
• The redevelopment under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme is expected to improve **passenger satisfaction**, ensure better connectivity, and promote regional development.
 
• The scheme includes provisions for **special facilities for differently-abled persons**, energy-efficient systems, and better logistics to cater to growing passenger needs.
 
• This initiative is part of the larger vision of **‘New India’**, aimed at modernizing infrastructure and promoting sustainable development. *Hence, option 3 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• **Amrit Bharat Station Scheme:**

 
 
• Launched by the Indian government, the **Amrit Bharat Station Scheme** aims to **develop, modernize, and upgrade existing railway stations** across India to cater to increasing passenger demands.
 
• The scheme focuses on **long-term planning** of stations, including the integration of digital systems, improved logistics, and sustainable energy practices.
 
• The redevelopment includes **better passenger amenities**, such as waiting lounges, parking facilities, drinking water kiosks, and improved station designs.
 
• The initiative also aims to improve **accessibility** for differently-abled persons and ensure adequate facilities for all passenger categories.
 
 
 
• **Other Government Schemes Related to Infrastructure:**
 
 
• **Smart Rail Mission:** Focuses on leveraging **digital technology** for operational efficiency and passenger convenience.
 
• **Udan Scheme:** Promotes regional air connectivity by making air travel accessible and affordable to the masses.
 
• **Bharat Mala Scheme:** Focuses on **road infrastructure**, including the construction of highways and expressways for better connectivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• **Significance of the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme:**

 
 
• The scheme plays a crucial role in **enhancing railway infrastructure**, which is essential for India’s socio-economic development.
 
• It aligns with the government’s focus on sustainable and inclusive development, ensuring improved services for all citizens.
 
• By modernizing railway stations, the initiative aims to make India’s transportation systems more efficient, accessible, and future-ready.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Regional Development:**
 
 
• Redeveloped stations are expected to boost **local tourism, trade, and economy** by improving connectivity across regions.
 
• The improved infrastructure will also encourage **private investment** and contribute to the overall growth of the Indian railway sector.
